subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103604 lands, should the temporary source-only `qa-matrix` package and its two private Matrix QA runtime exports be removed on this exact head?
rationale: The code and proof support the cleanup, but repository policy reserves intentional package/lockfile graph changes and compatibility-surface retirement for explicit owner or security approval.

options.title: Approve the stacked cleanup
options.body: Land the prerequisite PR first, authorize the exact-head dependency removal, and merge this owner-boundary cleanup as proposed.

options.title: Retain a temporary shim
options.body: Keep the package or runtime facade for one more cycle if a supported source-checkout consumer still depends on it, with a named removal plan.

options.title: Pause for consumer audit
options.body: Hold the final stack PR until maintainers confirm whether any external or internal automation imports the retired private surfaces.

recommendation.title: Approve the stacked cleanup
recommendation.body: Land the prerequisite PR first, authorize the exact-head dependency removal, and merge this owner-boundary cleanup as proposed.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-owner authority is required for the dependency-removal gate, and adjacent QA Lab history makes this the strongest available decision route.
